description: Senior Software Engineer specializing in real-time multimedia architectures, low-level systems (C++, POSIX threads, ALSA, Audio DSP), and modern full-stack web platforms (Python/Django, React, Node.js, Docker). Available for freelance & engineering contracts across Europe and remote.

aboutBio1: I am a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in high-performance audio/video systems, real-time multimedia streaming, and full-stack cloud architectures. With experience spanning low-level C++ (multi-threading, ALSA, digital signal processing), modern Python and JavaScript/TypeScript stacks (Django REST, React, Node.js), and DevOps automation (Docker, Linux, CI/CD), I bridge the gap between core systems performance and scalable web applications.
aboutBio2: Whether engineering low-latency audio equalizers, adaptive video streaming pipelines (MPEG-DASH/FFmpeg), or collaborative real-time web platforms, I focus on clean architecture, latency optimization, and robust engineering.
skillsSubtitle: A rare dual expertise combining low-level systems and signal processing with modern full-stack web and cloud architectures.
projectsSubtitle: Real-time multimedia systems, collaborative web applications, and low-latency audio processing engines.
cprogProject1Title: Hellqualizer — Real-Time C++ Audio Decoder & FIR Equalizer
cprogProject1Desc: High-performance C++ audio player and digital equalizer featuring custom Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter banks. Built with a decoupled multithreaded architecture for ultra-low latency playback.
cprogProject1H1: Three parallel POSIX threads (pthreads) orchestrating stream demuxing, FIR filtering, and real-time playback.
cprogProject1H2: Direct integration with the FFmpeg C API for decoding and native Linux ALSA API for audio rendering.
cprogProject1H3: Thread synchronization and producer-consumer ring buffers designed for zero audio dropouts.
cprogProject2Desc: Native Kotlin Android application capturing live microphone input and rendering real-time frequency spectrograms at 60 FPS.
cprogProject2H1: Direct hardware audio acquisition via the Android AudioRecord API.
cprogProject2H2: Optimized Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm computing frequency bins in real time.
cprogProject2H3: Hardware-accelerated custom Canvas rendering delivering fluid, low-overhead spectrogram displays.
webProject1Title: Cloud Video Streaming Platform & Ingest Engine
webProject1Desc: End-to-end video-on-demand and streaming platform inspired by Netflix, engineered with Django REST Framework, React, and MPEG-DASH.
webProject1H1: Automated backend video ingestion, metadata indexing, user authentication, and watch history tracking.
webProject1H2: Adaptive bitrate video streaming implemented with the MPEG-DASH protocol.
webProject1H3: Fully containerized with Docker and deployed on a private cluster for high reliability.
webProject2Title: Multi-Web Audio Sequencer — Real-Time Collaborative Studio
webProject2Desc: Interactive browser-based music sequencer allowing multiple distributed users to collaboratively compose music in real time.
webProject2H1: Real-time state synchronization across concurrent clients using WebSockets (Socket.io) on Express.js.
webProject2H2: Low-latency browser audio playback and synthesis powered by the Web Audio API.
webProject2H3: Deep integration with the Freesound.org sample database; selected and hosted on official Freesound Labs.

labStreamingDesc: Technical guide and command-line recipes for building adaptive live streaming pipelines with FFmpeg, MP4Box, and hardware video capture (macOS, Linux, Raspberry Pi).
labWebglTitle: WebGL Texture Filtering & Custom GLSL Shaders
labWebglDesc: Interactive WebGL demo showcasing a custom GLSL fragment shader applying real-time Gaussian blur filtering with variable intensity based on 3D coordinates.
